question: Should OpenClaw adopt `agents.run`, `phase`, and `log` as the permanent QuickJS Code Mode Swarm API once the replay and event-contract defects are repaired?
rationale: This is a new typed guest API with persisted restart behavior and a plugin-SDK execution-context change; code review can verify mechanics but cannot choose the permanent public product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded QuickJS API
options.body: Keep the feature behind `tools.swarm`, repair the concrete defects, and require real restart-recovery proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the API before merge
options.body: Retain only the smallest supported orchestration surface and defer progress globals or replay persistence until their contracts are separately designed.

options.title: Defer the feature direction
options.body: Pause this branch until a maintainer confirms the desired long-term Code Mode and Swarm API boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded QuickJS API
recommendation.body: Keep the feature behind `tools.swarm`, repair the concrete defects, and require real restart-recovery proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the author of the proposed API and replay design; a repository owner should make the final sponsorship decision.
